label.en: Eviction of an occupier without title

how.ar: النزاع يتعلق بعقار وبحق الملكية، فيعرض على القسم العقاري للمحكمة التي يقع العقار في دائرة اختصاصها؛ وتستعمل أحكام المحكمة التي لم تنشأ فيها الأقسام، والإحالة بين الأقسام، والمخرج نحو القضاء الإداري إذا كان أحد الأطراف هيئة عمومية وطنية، وطريق الاستعجال.
how.en: The dispute concerns real property and ownership, so it goes to the real-estate section of the court where the property lies; the rules for courts without sections, referral between sections, the exit to the administrative courts when a national public body is a party, and the urgent-matters route are used.

how.ar: يخرج النزاع عن القضاء العادي إذا كانت الدولة أو الولاية أو البلدية أو مؤسسة عمومية ذات صبغة إدارية طرفا فيه، ويتأثر بوجود متابعة جزائية عن نفس الوقائع (التعدي على الملكية العقارية)؛ والأمر الاستعجالي لا يمس أصل الحق.
how.en: The dispute leaves the ordinary courts when the State, a wilaya, a commune or a public administrative body is a party, and is affected by criminal proceedings on the same facts (trespass on real property); an urgent order does not touch the substance of the right.

how.ar: طلب التعويض عن الشغل دون وجه حق يخضع لتقادم دعوى التعويض عن الفعل الضار، ويسقط ريع الحائز سيء النية بخمس عشرة سنة؛ ولا تقضي المحكمة بالتقادم من تلقاء نفسها؛ وعلى الدائن إثبات الالتزام.
how.en: The claim for compensation for occupation without right falls under the limitation of the action for a harmful act, and revenue owed by a possessor in bad faith falls only after fifteen years; the court does not apply limitation of its own motion; the creditor proves the obligation.

how.ar: الإعذار أو المطالبة بالخروج عنصر من عناصر الدعوى: يطبق شرط الإعذار قبل التعويض وقبل الإجبار على التنفيذ العيني (رد العقار)، مع حالات الإعفاء، ومنها التعويض عن عمل مضر ورد شيء تسلمه المدين دون حق وهو عالم بذلك.
how.en: The notice or demand to leave is an element of the claim: the notice rule before damages and before compelling performance in kind (return of the property) applies, with its exemptions, among them compensation for a harmful act and the return of a thing the debtor received without right knowing it.

question.ar: هل دخل المدعى عليه العقار أول مرة بموجب عقد أو بإذن من المالك (إيجار أو عارية أو بيع أو وعد بالبيع أو سكن وظيفي أو غيره)، ولو انتهى ذلك العقد أو الإذن بعد ذلك؟
question.en: Did the defendant first enter the property under a contract or with the owner's permission (a lease, a loan for use, a sale or promise of sale, work housing or the like), even if that contract or permission has since ended?

proposedSlots.why: Boundary n1 reads it: Civil Code article 502 (tenant who keeps the property after the lease ends) and articles 538 and 546 (loan for use and its end) give the return of the property and compensation a contractual basis; the occupation is then not 'without any title' from the start.

says.ar: الملكية حق التمتع بالشيء والتصرف فيه في حدود ما لا تحرمه القوانين والأنظمة.
says.en: Ownership is the right to enjoy and dispose of a thing, within what laws and regulations do not forbid.

basis.interpretiveNote: The article defines ownership; that the owner may on this ground claim the property back from an occupier without title is a reading. The article that forbids depriving an owner of his property, and the rules on possession and acquisitive prescription, are not in the store (requests filed).

says.ar: كل فعل خاطئ يسبب ضررا للغير يلزم فاعله بالتعويض.
says.en: Any act committed through a person's fault that harms another obliges him to compensate.

says.ar: يقدر القاضي مدى التعويض عن الضرر وفق قواعد التعويض مع مراعاة الظروف الملابسة.
says.en: The judge assesses the extent of compensation for the harm under the compensation rules, taking the circumstances into account.

says.ar: إذا لم يقدر التعويض بالعقد أو بالقانون قدره القاضي، ويشمل ما لحق الدائن من خسارة وما فاته من كسب.
says.en: Where neither contract nor law fixes compensation, the judge fixes it, covering the loss suffered and the gain missed.

says.ar: العقود الناقلة لملكية عقار أو حقوق عقارية تحرر في شكل رسمي تحت طائلة البطلان.
says.en: Contracts transferring ownership of real property or real rights must be made in official form, on pain of nullity.

says.ar: ما ورد في العقد الرسمي حجة حتى يثبت تزويره.
says.en: What an official deed records is proof until it is shown to be forged.

says.ar: في غير المواد التجارية لا يثبت بالشهود تصرف قانوني تزيد قيمته على 100.000 دينار جزائري أو غير محدد القيمة ما لم يوجد نص بخلافه.
says.en: Outside commercial matters, a legal act worth more than 100.000 Algerian dinars, or of undetermined value, cannot be proved by witnesses unless a text says otherwise.

basis.interpretiveNote: The article governs legal acts. That the occupation itself, a material fact, is outside it, while a lease or loan the defendant alleges is within it, is a reading.

says.ar: لا يقاضي إلا من كانت له صفة ومصلحة قائمة أو محتملة يقرها القانون.
says.en: Only a person with standing and a present or potential interest recognised by law may sue.

says.ar: يثير القاضي تلقائيا انعدام الصفة في المدعي أو المدعى عليه.
says.en: The judge raises of his own motion the lack of standing of the plaintiff or the defendant.

says.ar: تشهر عريضة الدعوى بالمحافظة العقارية إذا تعلقت بعقار أو حق عيني عقاري مشهر، وتقدم في أول جلسة، تحت طائلة عدم القبول شكلا ما لم يثبت إيداعها للإشهار.
says.en: A petition concerning published real property or a published real right is published at the land registry and produced at the first hearing, on pain of formal inadmissibility unless its lodging for publication is proved.

says.ar: إذا كان التنفيذ العيني لا يتم إلا بفعل المدين نفسه جاز الحكم بإلزامه به وبغرامة إجبارية إن امتنع.
says.en: Where performance in kind can only be done by the debtor himself, the creditor may obtain a judgment ordering it with a penalty payment if he refuses.

says.ar: يؤمر بالنفاذ المعجل عند طلبه إذا كان الحكم مبنيا على عقد رسمي أو وعد معترف به أو حكم حائز لقوة الشيء المقضي به.
says.en: Provisional execution is ordered on request where the judgment rests on an official deed, an acknowledged promise or a final judgment.

says.ar: في غير ذلك يجوز للقاضي في حالة الاستعجال الأمر بالنفاذ المعجل بكفالة أو بدونها.
says.en: In other cases the judge may, in urgency, order provisional execution with or without security.

says.ar: يتحمل الخصم الخاسر المصاريف ما لم يقرر القاضي غير ذلك مع التسبيب.
says.en: The losing party bears the costs unless the judge, giving reasons, decides otherwise.

says.ar: يجوز للقاضي تلقائيا أو بطلب أحد الخصوم تعيين خبير أو أكثر.
says.en: The judge may, of his own motion or at a party's request, appoint one or more experts.

says.ar: يرد المستأجر العين عند انتهاء الإيجار، فإن أبقاها دون حق دفع تعويضا باعتبار القيمة الإيجارية والضرر.
says.en: The tenant returns the property when the lease ends; if he keeps it without right he pays compensation based on the rental value and the harm.

says.ar: العارية عقد يسلم به المعير شيئا للمستعير ليستعمله بلا عوض ثم يرده.
says.en: A loan for use is a contract by which the lender hands a thing to the borrower to use free of charge and then return.

says.ar: تنتهي العارية بانقضاء أجلها أو باستعمال الشيء فيما أعير له.
says.en: A loan for use ends when its term runs out or when the thing has been used for its purpose.

says.ar: إذا تعذر تعيين مدة العارية جاز للمعير طلب إنهائها في أي وقت.
says.en: Where the duration of the loan cannot be fixed, the lender may ask to end it at any time.

says.ar: لا تقبل دعاوى الحيازة، ومنها دعوى الاسترداد، إذا لم ترفع خلال سنة من التعرض.
says.en: Possessory actions, recovery of possession included, are inadmissible unless brought within a year of the disturbance.

says.ar: يرفع دعوى استرداد الحيازة من اغتصبت منه حيازة عقار بالتعدي أو الإكراه.
says.en: The action to recover possession of real property belongs to whoever was dispossessed by trespass or force.

says.ar: لا تفصل المحكمة المطروحة عليها دعوى الحيازة في الملكية.
says.en: The court hearing a possessory action does not rule on ownership.

says.ar: لا تقبل دعوى الحيازة ممن سلك طريق دعوى الملكية.
says.en: A possessory action is not admitted from a person who has taken the ownership route.

says.ar: يجوز لقاضي الاستعجال الحكم بالغرامات التهديدية وتصفيتها.
says.en: The urgent-matters judge may order penalty payments and liquidate them.

toProve.en: The plaintiff owns the occupied property.

factsToState.ar: سند الملكية (عقد رسمي أو حكم أو دفتر عقاري) وتاريخه ومراجع شهره.
factsToState.en: The title deed (official deed, judgment or land book), its date and its publication references.
The property's location, boundaries and area.

note.ar: نقل ملكية العقار لا يكون إلا بعقد رسمي، والعقد الرسمي حجة حتى يثبت تزويره.
note.en: A transfer of real property is valid only by official deed, and an official deed is proof until shown forged.

toProve.ar: شغل المدعى عليه للعقار دون عقد أو سند يبرره.
toProve.en: The defendant occupies the property without any contract or title that justifies it.

factsToState.ar: تاريخ بدء الشغل وكيفيته، ومن يشغل العقار مع المدعى عليه.
factsToState.en: When and how the occupation began, and who occupies the property with the defendant.

factsToState.ar: انعدام أي إيجار أو عارية أو بيع أو إذن من المالك.
factsToState.en: The absence of any lease, loan, sale or permission from the owner.

note.ar: الشغل واقعة مادية؛ ومن يدعي من الطرفين وجود عقد يثبته، ولا يثبت بالشهود تصرف قانوني تزيد قيمته على الحد المقرر.
note.en: Occupation is a material fact; a party who alleges a contract proves it, and a legal act above the statutory value is not proved by witnesses.

proof.means: rules on proof of legal acts

toProve.ar: توجيه إعذار أو مطالبة بالخروج إلى المدعى عليه قبل رفع الدعوى، أو قيام حالة إعفاء.
toProve.en: A formal notice or demand to leave was served on the defendant before the claim, or an exemption applies.

factsToState.ar: تاريخ الإعذار ووسيلته (محضر قضائي) ورد المدعى عليه.
factsToState.en: The date and means of the notice (bailiff) and the defendant's response.

toProve.ar: الضرر الناجم عن الشغل دون وجه حق ومقداره (الحرمان من الانتفاع والقيمة الإيجارية).
toProve.en: The harm caused by the occupation without right and its amount (loss of use, rental value).

factsToState.ar: مدة الشغل والقيمة الإيجارية للعقار والمبلغ المطلوب.
factsToState.en: The length of the occupation, the property's rental value and the sum claimed.

text.ar: الحكم بطرد المدعى عليه ومن يقوم مقامه أو يشغل بإذنه من العقار الكائن بـ(...) وإلزامه بإخلائه وتسليمه للمدعي.
text.en: Order the eviction of the defendant, and of anyone occupying through him, from the property at (...), and order him to vacate it and hand it to the plaintiff.

text.ar: إلزام المدعى عليه بأن يدفع للمدعي مبلغ (...) دج تعويضا عن شغل العقار دون وجه حق، واحتياطيا تعيين خبير لتقدير القيمة الإيجارية ومقدار التعويض.
text.en: Order the defendant to pay the plaintiff (...) DZD as compensation for occupying the property without right, and in the alternative appoint an expert to assess the rental value and the compensation.

text.ar: الحكم على المدعى عليه بغرامة تهديدية قدرها (...) دج عن كل يوم تأخير في الإخلاء.
text.en: Order the defendant to pay a penalty of (...) DZD for each day of delay in vacating.
Order provisional execution of the judgment.
Order the defendant to bear the costs.

message.ar: المادتان 511 و512 من قانون الإجراءات المدنية والإدارية: ينظر القسم العقاري في المنازعات المتعلقة بالأملاك العقارية وفي حق الملكية والحيازة؛ وفي المحاكم التي لم تنشأ فيها الأقسام ينظر القسم المدني (المادة 32). تحقق من القسم المختار.
message.en: CPCA articles 511 and 512: the real-estate section hears disputes on real property, ownership and possession; in courts where sections have not been created the civil section hears them (article 32). Check the section chosen.

priorSteps.interpretiveNote: Article 17 requires publication of a petition that 'concerns' published real property, on pain of formal inadmissibility. Article 519 refers to the special rules on publishing actions to rescind, annul, amend or undo rights based on published deeds, which suggests a narrower scope. Whether a claim to evict an occupier, which does not touch the published title, falls within article 17 is a reading; the step therefore warns and never blocks.

reading.ar: كل عريضة تتعلق بعقار مشهر، ومنها دعوى الطرد، يجب شهرها تحت طائلة عدم القبول شكلا.
reading.en: Every petition concerning published property, eviction included, must be published, on pain of formal inadmissibility.

reading.ar: لا يلزم الشهر إلا في الدعاوى الرامية إلى إبطال أو فسخ أو تعديل أو نقض حقوق قائمة على عقود مشهرة، ودعوى الطرد ليست منها.
reading.en: Publication is needed only for actions to annul, rescind, amend or undo rights based on published deeds, and an eviction claim is not one of them.

message.ar: المادة 17 من قانون الإجراءات المدنية والإدارية: تشهر عريضة الدعوى المتعلقة بعقار مشهر بالمحافظة العقارية وتقدم في أول جلسة تحت طائلة عدم القبول شكلا، والمادة 519 تحيل إلى أحكام شهر دعاوى الفسخ والإبطال. مدى انطباق ذلك على دعوى الطرد محل قراءتين. تحقق من إيداع العريضة للإشهار.
message.en: CPCA article 17: a petition concerning property published at the land registry is published there and produced at the first hearing, on pain of formal inadmissibility; article 519 refers to the rules on publishing rescission and annulment claims. Two readings exist on whether this reaches an eviction claim. Check whether the petition was lodged for publication.

name.ar: سند ملكية المدعي (عقد رسمي مشهر أو حكم أو دفتر عقاري)
name.en: The plaintiff's title (a published official deed, a judgment or a land book)

why.en: To prove the plaintiff's standing and ownership of the property.

name.ar: ما يثبت إيداع العريضة للإشهار بالمحافظة العقارية
name.en: Proof that the petition was lodged for publication at the land registry

why.ar: تقدم العريضة المشهرة أو ما يثبت إيداعها في أول جلسة.
why.en: The published petition, or proof of its lodging, is produced at the first hearing.

name.ar: محضر معاينة يثبت شغل العقار وهوية الشاغل
name.en: A findings report recording the occupation and the occupier's identity

why.ar: لإثبات واقعة الشغل، وهي واقعة مادية.
why.en: To prove the occupation, a material fact.

looksLike.en: Eviction of an occupier without title

tellingFacts.ar: دخل المدعى عليه العقار بعقد إيجار أو عارية أو بيع أو بإذن من المالك ثم انتهى ذلك.
tellingFacts.en: The defendant entered under a lease, a loan for use, a sale or the owner's permission, which has since ended.

message.ar: القانون المدني: يرد المستأجر العين عند انتهاء الإيجار ويعوض عن إبقائها دون حق (المادة 502)، وتنتهي العارية بانقضاء أجلها أو بطلب المعير (المادة 546). تحقق من الأساس العقدي للدعوى ومن انتهاء العقد.
message.en: Civil Code: the tenant returns the property when the lease ends and pays compensation for keeping it without right (article 502), and a loan for use ends at its term or at the lender's request (article 546). Check the contractual basis of the claim and whether the contract has ended.

looksLike.en: Eviction of an occupier without title

tellingFacts.ar: المدعي حائز لا يملك سندا، أو اغتصبت حيازته بالتعدي أو الإكراه منذ أقل من سنة.
tellingFacts.en: The plaintiff is a possessor without a title, or was dispossessed by trespass or force less than a year ago.

message.ar: قانون الإجراءات المدنية والإدارية: دعوى استرداد الحيازة لمن اغتصبت حيازته (المادة 525) ترفع خلال سنة من التعرض (المادة 524)، ولا تفصل في الملكية (المادة 527)، ولا تقبل ممن سلك طريق دعوى الملكية (المادة 529). تحقق من الطريق المختار قبل رفع الدعوى.
message.en: CPCA: the action to recover possession (article 525) is brought within a year of the disturbance (article 524), does not decide ownership (article 527), and is not admitted from one who took the ownership route (article 529). Check the route chosen before filing.

looksLike.en: Eviction of an occupier without title

tellingFacts.ar: الشاغل مطلقة حاضنة أو فرد من الأسرة يستند إلى حق في السكن.
tellingFacts.en: The occupier is a divorced custodian or a family member relying on a right to housing.

message.ar: المادة 72 من قانون الأسرة: على الأب عند الطلاق توفير سكن ملائم للحاضنة أو أجرته. تحقق من وجود حق في السكن قبل وصف الشاغل بأنه بدون سند.
message.en: Family Code article 72: on divorce the father provides suitable housing for the custodian or pays its rent. Check for a right to housing before treating the occupier as without title.

looksLike.en: Eviction of an occupier without title

tellingFacts.ar: الشاغل شريك في الشيوع أو وارث للمالك.
tellingFacts.en: The occupier is a co-owner in indivision or an heir of the owner.

message.ar: المادة 512 من قانون الإجراءات المدنية والإدارية تذكر الملكية على الشيوع والقسمة ضمن اختصاص القسم العقاري. تحقق مما إذا كان الشاغل شريكا في الملكية قبل وصفه بأنه بدون سند.
message.en: CPCA article 512 lists co-ownership in indivision and partition among the real-estate section's matters. Check whether the occupier is a co-owner before treating him as without title.

question.ar: هل يجب شهر عريضة دعوى طرد شاغل بدون سند من عقار مشهر؟
question.en: Must a petition to evict an occupier without title from published property be published at the land registry?

why.ar: عبارة المادة 17 عامة («إذا تعلقت بعقار مشهر»)، بينما تحيل المادة 519 إلى شهر دعاوى الفسخ والإبطال والتعديل والنقض فقط، ونصوص الشهر العقاري الخاصة ليست في المخزن.
why.en: Article 17 is worded broadly ('concerns published property'), while article 519 refers only to publishing rescission, annulment, amendment and undoing claims, and the land-registry texts are not in the store.

reading.ar: يجب الشهر تحت طائلة عدم القبول شكلا.
reading.en: Publication is required, on pain of formal inadmissibility.

reading.ar: لا يجب الشهر لأن دعوى الطرد لا تمس الحقوق المشهرة.
reading.en: Publication is not required because eviction does not touch the published rights.

protectiveReading.ar: التنبيه إلى الشهر دون منع التصدير.

question.ar: هل يلزم إعذار الشاغل بدون سند قبل طلب طرده وقبل طلب التعويض، أم يندرج في حالة رد شيء تسلمه المدين دون حق وهو عالم بذلك أو في حالة التعويض عن عمل مضر؟
question.en: Must an occupier without title be put on notice before eviction and damages are claimed, or does he fall within the exemption for returning a thing received without right knowingly, or for compensation for a harmful act?

why.ar: المادة 164 تشترط الإعذار للإجبار على التنفيذ العيني، والمادة 181 تعفي في حالات منها رد شيء تسلمه المدين دون حق وهو عالم، ولا يحدد النص ما إذا كان الشاغل بدون سند «تسلم» العقار.
why.en: Article 164 requires notice to compel performance in kind and article 181 exempts, among others, the return of a thing received without right knowingly; the text does not say whether an occupier without title 'received' the property.

protectiveReading.ar: يطبق شرط الإعذار المستورد مع حالات الإعفاء، فيسأل عن الإعذار وينبه عند غيابه دون منع.
protectiveReading.en: Apply the imported notice rule with its exemptions: ask about the notice and warn when it is missing, never block.

question.ar: من أي تاريخ يسري تقادم طلب التعويض عن شغل مستمر؟
question.en: From what date does limitation run on compensation for a continuing occupation?

why.ar: المادة 133 تجعل المدة من يوم وقوع الفعل الضار، والشغل فعل مستمر؛ والمادة 309 تجعل ريع الحائز سيء النية لا يتقادم إلا بخمس عشرة سنة.
why.en: Article 133 counts from the day of the harmful act, and occupation is a continuing act; article 309 makes revenue owed by a possessor in bad faith fall only after fifteen years.

reading.en: The period runs from the start of the occupation.

reading.ar: تسري لكل فترة شغل من يومها، فلا يسقط إلا ما تجاوز خمس عشرة سنة.
reading.en: It runs for each period of occupation from that period, so only what is older than fifteen years falls.

protectiveReading.ar: يحسب من تاريخ بدء الشغل (أبكر تاريخ) فينبه أسرع، ويبقى التنبيه دون منع.
protectiveReading.en: Count from the start of the occupation (the earliest date), which warns sooner; it stays a warning.

question.ar: هل تسقط دعوى الملكية (الاسترداد) بالتقادم، وهل يحتج الشاغل بالتقادم المكسب؟
question.en: Does the ownership action fall by limitation, and can the occupier rely on acquisitive prescription?

why.ar: أحكام الحيازة والتقادم المكسب في القانون المدني ليست في المخزن؛ ويعتقد من الذاكرة أن الحيازة الهادئة المستمرة مدة خمس عشرة سنة تكسب الملكية.
why.en: The Civil Code rules on possession and acquisitive prescription are not in the store; from memory, quiet continuous possession for fifteen years acquires ownership.

protectiveReading.ar: لا قاعدة؛ يذكر للمحامي التحقق من مدة الشغل ومن دفع محتمل بالتقادم المكسب.
protectiveReading.en: No rule; the lawyer is told to check the length of the occupation and a possible plea of acquisitive prescription.

question.ar: ما النص الذي يمنع حرمان المالك من ملكه ويحدد ثمار الحائز سيء النية؟
question.en: Which text forbids depriving an owner of his property and sets the fruits owed by a possessor in bad faith?

why.ar: لا يحتوي المخزن من باب الملكية إلا تعريفها؛ ويعتقد من الذاكرة أن مواد لاحقة تمنع الحرمان من الملكية وتلزم الحائز سيء النية برد الثمار.
why.en: The store holds only the definition of ownership; from memory, later articles forbid deprivation of ownership and make the possessor in bad faith liable for fruits.

protectiveReading.ar: يبقى الأساس المادة 674 قراءة، مع طلب النصوص.
protectiveReading.en: Article 674 stays the basis as a reading, and the texts are requested.

question.ar: وحدات الاختصاص الإقليمي والشهر العقاري والإثبات والطلبات التبعية وبيانات العريضة لا سجل نهائيا لها؛ فهل تحل محل البنود التي كتبها هذا السجل؟
question.en: The territorial-jurisdiction, land-registry-publication, proof, accessory-requests and petition-formal-elements modules have no final record; should they replace the items this record wrote?

why.ar: لم يتح استيرادها، فكتب السجل بياناته الخاصة (المادة 17، الإثبات، الغرامة التهديدية، النفاذ المعجل، المصاريف، الصفة) واستورد قاعدة الإقليم من وحدة أقسام المحكمة.
why.en: They could not be imported, so this record wrote its own statements (article 17, proof, penalty payment, provisional execution, costs, standing) and imported the territory rule from the court-sections module.

protectiveReading.ar: عند صدور السجلات النهائية تستورد بنودها ويحذف ما يكررها هنا.
protectiveReading.en: When the final records exist, import their blocks and remove what this record duplicates.

question.ar: هل يطبق نص المادة 124 بصيغته المعدلة على شغل بدأ قبل التعديل؟
question.en: Does article 124 in its amended wording apply to an occupation that began before the amendment?

why.ar: يحمل المخزن ملاحظة بأن تاريخ سريان التعديل غير محسوم، والشغل فعل مستمر.
why.en: The store notes that the amendment's start date is unsettled, and occupation is a continuing act.

protectiveReading.ar: يذكر النص بصيغته النافذة دون أثر على التنبيهات.
protectiveReading.en: Cite the wording in force; it has no effect on the warnings.

question.ar: متى يجوز طلب الطرد أمام قاضي الاستعجال بدل قاضي الموضوع؟
question.en: When may eviction be sought from the urgent-matters judge instead of the judge of the merits?

why.ar: المواد 299 و303 و521 تتيح الاستعجال والتدابير التحفظية دون المساس بأصل الحق، ولا تذكر طرد الشاغل بدون سند صراحة.
why.en: Articles 299, 303 and 521 allow urgent and protective measures without touching the substance, and do not name eviction of an occupier without title.

protectiveReading.en: Mention the route as a boundary, with no rule.

checklist.item: Basis of the right: the Civil Code definition of ownership (the owner's right to enjoy and dispose of the thing) and the rule that no owner may be deprived of his property except as the law provides; the owner may claim his thing from whoever holds it without right (revendication).
checklist.note: Article 674 is in the store; the article forbidding deprivation of ownership is not (requested). The revendication right is a reading of article 674.

checklist.item: Ground for damages: the general tort article of the Civil Code (any fault that causes harm to another obliges its author to compensate), and the rules on the fruits owed by a possessor in bad faith.
checklist.note: Article 124 in the store; the possession chapter on fruits is not (requested); article 309 mentions revenue owed by a possessor in bad faith.

checklist.item: Element 1: the plaintiff's ownership of the property: an official deed (notarial, judicial or administrative) published at the land registry, or a livret foncier; check whether the property is registered and whether a private deed without fixed date can carry ownership of real property (it cannot, for transfers after 1971).
checklist.note: Official form on pain of nullity is in article 324 مكرر 1. The publication rule of the Civil Code and the 1971 cut-off are not in the store.

checklist.item: Element 2: the defendant's occupation of the property, its start date, and the absence of any contract or title (no lease, no loan for use, no sale promise, no co-ownership, no family right of residence).
Element 3 (for damages): the harm (loss of use, rental value) and its amount, usually fixed by an expert; the causal link with the occupation.
Burden of proof: the plaintiff proves ownership and the occupation; the defendant who claims a title must prove it (the one who alleges a release proves it).
Proof of the occupation: bailiff's report of findings (محضر معاينة), witnesses; occupation is a material fact provable by any means.
checklist.note: The texts on bailiffs' findings reports are not in the store; that material facts are outside the witness limit is a reading of article 333 (b7 interpretive).

checklist.item: Competent section: the real-estate section (القسم العقاري) of the court of first instance; if the court has no such section, the civil section; listing before the wrong section is not a ground of inadmissibility but a referral.

Urgent route: eviction of an occupier without title is often asked of the summary judge (قاضي الاستعجال) when the lack of title is obvious and there is urgency; the summary judge cannot rule if there is a serious dispute on the merits (ownership contested).
checklist.note: Articles 299, 303 and 521: the urgent order does not touch the substance; article 521 lets the real-estate section president take protective measures even with a serious dispute. No text names eviction of an occupier.

checklist.item: Territorial jurisdiction: in real-property matters the court where the property lies; check whether this rule is of public order.
checklist.note: Article 40 says 'دون سواها' (and no other); whether this is of public order is not stated in the texts read.

checklist.item: Exit to the administrative courts: if the State, a wilaya, a commune or a public administrative body is a party (as owner or occupier), the administrative court is competent under the organic criterion.
Exit to commercial courts: unlikely; check whether the occupied premises are business premises and the dispute is between traders.
checklist.note: An occupation without any contract is not one of the matters of the specialised commercial court (article 536 مكرر); a commercial lease is a lease, handled by boundary n1.

checklist.item: Exit to the criminal judge: occupation by trespass (التعدي على الملكية العقارية) is an offence in the Penal Code; if a criminal case is pending on the same facts, the civil judge may stay (the criminal holds the civil in abeyance).
checklist.note: The Penal Code article on trespass and the Code of Criminal Procedure are not in the store (penal code requested for context).

checklist.item: Limitation: the ownership action (revendication) does not prescribe by itself, but the defendant may raise acquisitive prescription (15 years of possession, or 10 with just title and good faith) as a defence.
checklist.note: Searched the civil-code text view: only article 674 of the ownership book is present; no possession or acquisitive prescription articles (requested).

checklist.item: Limitation of the damages claim: tort action prescribes 15 years from the harmful act; periodic sums (rental value) may prescribe 5 years; check which applies to occupation compensation.
checklist.note: Article 309 paragraph 2 keeps revenue owed by a possessor in bad faith at fifteen years, so the five-year periodic period is not imported.

checklist.item: Possessory actions (recovery of possession) have a one-year period from dispossession; they are a different action from the ownership-based eviction and should not be confused.
Who raises limitation: the debtor/defendant only, not the court of its own motion.

Formal notice (إعذار): not legally required before the eviction of an occupier without title; it is required before contractual damages, but not when the compensation arises from a harmful act; a notice by bailiff is nonetheless useful as proof of bad faith and of the start of fruits owed.
checklist.note: The texts do not exempt eviction as such; the exemptions of article 181 (harmful act, thing received without right knowingly) are the route. Kept as ask/warn.

checklist.item: Bad faith of the possessor: the possessor in bad faith owes the fruits from the day he became in bad faith; a possessor in good faith keeps the fruits until the claim is filed.
checklist.note: Searched the civil-code text view for the possession chapter (fruits of the possessor): absent (requested).

checklist.item: Publication of the petition at the land registry: required when the claim seeks annulment, rescission, revocation or cancellation of published rights; probably not required for a pure eviction, but required if the claim also seeks to annul the defendant's deed.
checklist.note: Article 17 paragraph 3 is broader than remembered ('concerns published property'); kept interpretive, warn.

checklist.item: Petition formal elements: court, parties' names and addresses, summary of facts and requests, supporting documents; fees paid; standing (the owner or his representative) and interest.
checklist.note: The petition-formal-elements module has no final record; standing statements written here, the rest left to that module.

checklist.item: Required documents: ownership deed (published), certificate of non-appeal if title comes from a judgment, bailiff's report of occupation, notice if any, land registry certificate (شهادة عقارية).
checklist.note: No text in the store on the land-registry certificate or the certificate of non-appeal.

checklist.item: Co-ownership boundary: a co-owner in indivision occupying the common property is not an occupier without title; the remedy is partition or compensation for exclusive use.
checklist.note: The Civil Code articles on indivision are not in the store (requested for context); boundary kept as a note.

checklist.item: Lease boundary: a tenant whose lease expired or was rescinded is evicted under the lease rules (expulsion of tenant), not as an occupier without title; an oral lease or the receipt of rent may prove a lease.
Family boundary: a spouse or relative living in the marital home or the family dwelling may have a right of residence (custody housing); a divorced wife with custody may have a right to housing.
Heirs boundary: an heir occupying estate property is a co-owner, not an occupier without title.
Sale promise / buyer in possession boundary: a buyer under a private sale who is in possession has a contractual claim to defend; the dispute is about the validity of the sale.
Unregistered property / possession-based ownership: if the plaintiff only holds a possession certificate (شهادة حيازة) or private deed, his standing to evict may be contested.
checklist.note: The possession-certificate texts are not in the store.

checklist.item: Requests: eviction of the defendant and of anyone occupying through him; compensation for occupation; penalty payment (غرامة تهديدية) to enforce the eviction; costs; provisional execution where allowed.
Provisional execution: possible by law in some cases and at the judge's discretion in others; check the CPCA article.
Penalty payment: the judge may order a penalty payment to enforce an obligation to do (leave the premises).
Amendments: CPCA Law 08-09 of 2008 amended by Law 22-13 of 2022; the Civil Code amended by Law 05-10 of 2005 (article 124 reformulated).
checklist.note: The store gives article 124 in the law-05-10 wording; law 22-13 matters here only through the administrative-court exit.

checklist.item: Expert appointment: rental value / compensation commonly assessed by a court-appointed expert; the petition may ask for one.
Store note on Civil Code article 124: the start date of the 2005 wording is unsettled. Does it change the basis for an occupation that began before 2005?
Store notes on Civil Code articles 502, 538, 546 and 547 (and 133): the text is a snapshot at a cut-off date with no lawyer verification. Is a later amendment of these articles possible?
checklist.note: Cited as the store has them; no later wording in the store.

examples.title: Clean case: published title, petition lodged, bailiff notice before filing, occupation since 2024.
Occupation began in 2010: the damages limitation is far past (a limitation only warns).
Fifteen years end a week after the petition: inside the band, a warning.
No notice served and no exemption: both notice steps warn, never block.
No notice, but the occupier holds the property knowingly without right and the damages are for a harmful act: exemptions.
Whether a notice was served is unknown: the notice steps ask.
Published property, petition not lodged for publication: a warning (reading), never a block.
Publication step: lodging unknown asks; property not published needs nothing; registration unknown asks.
Property not published at the land registry: no publication step.
Registration unknown: the publication step asks whether the property is published.
The occupier is a commune: exit to the administrative court.
A trespass complaint is pending on the same facts: criminal exit warns.
The defendant entered as a tenant whose lease has ended: boundary warns.
Court without a real-estate section: civil section proposed.
Eviction only, no damages: the damages notice step does not apply.
